title: A0 to A4 / Letter Sewing Pattern Tiler — True 100% Scale
description: Convert A0 PDF sewing patterns, woodworking templates, and 1:1 blueprints to A4 or US Letter sheets at exact 100% scale with calibration rulers.
h1: A0 to A4 / Letter Pattern Tiler (100% True Scale)
lead: Preset to True Scale (100%) and Vector PDF clipping so A0 sewing patterns, cosplay templates, and woodworking plans print at exact 1:1 dimensions.

sections.heading: Why Exact 1:1 Scale Is Critical for Patterns & Templates
paragraphs: When printing an A0 sewing pattern, guitar template, or woodworking jig, a 3% 'Fit to Page' shrink from a PDF reader ruins every seam allowance across the garment. WidePosterMaker defaults this tool page to True Scale = 100%, reading the physical page size directly from your A0/A1 PDF.

Every multi-page export starts with Page 1 containing an Assembly Map plus exact vector 50 mm and 2 inch test bars. Print Page 1 first, lay a ruler against the bar, and confirm 100% accuracy before printing the full pattern.
list: Load your A0 PDF pattern (use Prev/Next if your file includes multiple garment sheets).
Confirm Size By stays on True Scale (%) = 100 and select A4 or US Letter paper.
Click any completely blank corner tiles on the preview to skip printing empty sheets.
In Adobe Reader, Chrome, or Preview, select 'Actual Size' (100%) and verify the 50 mm / 2 in calibration ruler on Page 1.

sections.heading: Preserving Multi-Layer & Fine Pattern Markings
paragraphs: Because WidePosterMaker embeds and clips the original PDF page as a vector Form XObject, fine notch marks, dashed seam lines, grain arrows, and tiny size labels remain crisp at full printer DPI.

faqs.q: Will an A0 PDF sewing pattern keep exact 1:1 dimensions on A4 or Letter?
faqs.a: Yes. In True Scale (100%) mode, WidePosterMaker reads the PDF's physical point dimensions (1 inch = 72 pt) and maps them 1:1 onto A4 or US Letter tiles without rescaling.

faqs.q: How do I avoid printing blank sheets in an irregularly shaped pattern?
faqs.a: Click any empty tile cell on the interactive grid preview to toggle it off before downloading the PDF. Skipped tiles also appear crossed out on your Assembly Map.

faqs.q: Can I also scale a pattern up or down by percentage (e.g. 95% or 105%)?
faqs.a: Yes — change the Target Value in True Scale (%) mode from 100 to any percentage between 5% and 2000%.

faqs.q: What glue overlap works best for taping sewing patterns?
faqs.a: 10 mm (about 3/8 inch) is ideal for overlapping A4/Letter sheets with a glue stick or removable tape without adding bulk.
